question: Is seed 44's s009-LM competing basin (~100° from truth) visible at 2046-Sobol resolution, and is it a body-symmetry artefact?
hypothesis: Seed 44's competing basin is a sub-Sobol-resolution narrow basin (case A), real but invisible at 2046 density and not at a body-symmetry pole.
narrative_md: Seed 44's s009 competing basin (~100° from truth, final_mse 0.06 mag^2) is case (A): a sub-Sobol-resolution narrow basin. Truth remains global argmin (3.36e-4 mag^2); n_sobol_below_truth = 0; no Sobol point within 10° of the LM landing. The landing q0 is not at any clean rigid-body symmetry pole (closest 180°y at 81.9°), so it is a genuine surrogate-MSE local minimum, not a body-symmetry artefact — same regime as seed 28's truth basin in s006.
